# Mobile Testing Governance

> **Authority**: `AGENTS.md` § 15, § 23, § 25, § 27, and the detailed reference
> at `docs/reference/instructions/04-mobile-testing.detail.md`.

## Default Context

This file is a compact routing stub. Load the detailed reference only when a
task touches Capacitor deployment readiness, mobile gestures, safe areas,
offline persistence, app suspension, native integrations, or mobile performance
evidence.

## Required Rules

- Validate safe-area handling, touch gestures, offline persistence, and app
  lifecycle behavior for mobile surfaces.
- Check tap-to-feedback latency, memory behavior, and launch performance for
  mobile readiness claims.
- Preserve accessibility and keyboard alternatives even for touch-first flows.
- Follow `AGENTS.md` § 0.A for validation and self-correction.
